field_patches.description_long: President Donald Trump spoke at a Turning Point USA campaign-style rally in Arizona in April 2026, during a trip NPR described as an effort to build Republican support in battleground states before the midterm elections. NPR’s transcript places the appearance amid public opposition to the war in Iran and quotes Trump saying the United States had been defending Americans because Iran could not have a nuclear weapon; the report says the crowd cheered during that passage. The Associated Press video headline says Trump said the United States would go into Iran and excavate uranium, while the AP description says he suggested Iran had agreed to hand over enriched uranium. NPR also reports that an average of polls put Trump’s approval at 39%, described as a record low. Trump’s statement did not itself constitute an Iranian agreement or establish that a uranium retrieval operation had occurred.
